description: Google Maps patch for ReVanced GmsCore, enabled by default for Morphe Desktop Quick mode. Preserves original Google Intent actions accepted by ReVanced GmsCore while routing package, provider, and permission identifiers, including Timeline semantic location, MicroG account access, and Phenotype service resolution. Supports Google Maps 26.29.02.946673643, current stable target 26.28.03.942936911, previous stable target 26.27.05.941319029, and legacy target 26.26.04.935742811.
